title: Executive at Systems Integration Firm Remains Bullish on Snowflake’s Growth and AI Opportunity
expert: Managing partner at a systems-integration firm with >90% of business on Snowflake (mid-market to Fortune 50)
verdict: The firm, with >90% of its business on Snowflake, grew Snowflake revenue 30%–40% y/y in Aug–Oct [[1 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268567&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse15548&hl=fse15548,fse15615,fse19145,fse19198&page=2), slowing from 72% a year earlier, while AI adds an estimated 15–20 pts of consumption growth [[7 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268567&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse19494&hl=fse19494,fse20812&page=2).

Demand / orders: 🟡 firm Snowflake business +30%–40% y/y (Aug–Oct) vs 72% in prior-year Q4 and ~20% expected next Q4; in line with Cleveland global SI +40% in 1H26 (SB #45418). → Tenet 1 (core re-acceleration) → [[1 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268567&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse15548&hl=fse15548,fse15615,fse19145,fse19198&page=2)

changes: Firm's Snowflake growth +30%–40% (Aug–Oct) vs 72% in its prior-year Q4: slowing; in line with Cleveland global SI +40% in 1H26 (SB #45418).
Cortex Code usage ~30% of customers vs KeyBanc ~50% of active users (SB #61004): lower (different base).

thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (core re-acceleration): → — 15%–20% organic consumption plus 15–20 pts from AI supports high-30s, but the firm's own growth is slowing.
Tenet 2 (AI second engine): ↑ — AI adds 15–20 pts of consumption; CoWork ~80% and Cortex Code ~50% adoption (estimates).
Tenet 3 (governed-data control point): → — 7/10 wins vs Fabric, ~50/50 vs Databricks.
Tenet 5 (architecture shift manageable): ↓ — 10%–15% of deals stalled on agent-deployment uncertainty.
